cast.name: 黛德雷·福雷斯特 Deirdre Forrest

introduction: Violeta is a soft-spoken, shy waitress at an upscale French restaurant in London. Everything about Violeta's life looks great on the surface: her manager Matt is charming, she's earning good money, and the restaurant is about to do exceedingly well thanks to a new deal from an investor, Charlotte. However, when Matt hosts a party at the restaurant to seal the financial deal with the investor, a suspicious Charlotte notices something much darker is happening under the surface of the restaurant. Violeta must decide whether she will reveal a twisted truth or keep a secret she's been hiding for years.
